text: Long coffee with Chioma. She's 20 weeks now and the scan on November 12 showed a girl. Her husband Tadhg is already painting the nursery yellow. Need to ask her about the christening plans nearer the time. Tadhg's parents are flying over from Cork for the birth, which Chioma is quietly dreading.

Lila and Luis are flying to Lisbon on 2 November 2026 for their anniversary. Lila hates long flights so they're breaking it up with a night in Madrid. Luis wants a decent camera before they go, hint hint.
Theo's band has a gig at the Fleece on Nov 21. He's properly nervous, first time doing his own songs. Don't forget to text him good luck that afternoon.
Caught up with Ilse after choir. Her sister Lola had the baby on Sunday, a boy called Felix, 8lb 2oz. Ilse is flying to Hamburg next week to meet him. Send Lola a card.
Eli's half marathon was cancelled because of the storm warning. He'd trained since June so he's gutted. They've moved it to March 2027 apparently.
Khadija mentioned her brother Kieran is running the Dublin marathon again. He finished in 3:40 last year. She thinks he'll smash it this time.
Dentist Thursday 9am. Pick up passport photos on the way back.
Zhang and Dorota's christening for baby Mia is on December 6th at St Anne's. I'm doing the cake. Dorota's mum is flying in from Kraków the week before. Should ask Zhang what time they want us there.

Lars rang. He and Björn are off to Japan for three weeks from 4/12, mostly Tokyo and Kyoto. Björn's never done a long-haul flight and is dreading the 14 hours. Lars wants restaurant tips. Must send him that ramen list Akira gave me. Also they land back on May 3rd, right before Björn's birthday.
Adriana got the lead in the school play, Annie, opening February 3rd. Her dad's over the moon. Aarav said they're doing three nights and the Friday is already sold out.
Yetunde is expecting! Due in May 2027. She's been really sick in the mornings though, can barely keep toast down. Text her next week to see how she's holding up.
Rosa's piano recital went well apparently, though she fluffed the Chopin. Her teacher still put her forward for the regional competition in January. I should ask her mum for the date.

Rana said her and Ruby have finally booked Peru for March 2027. Machu Picchu trek, four days. Ruby's training already, stairs every morning. Rana's worried about the altitude with her asthma. Ruby's sister Freya might join them for the Lima bit at the end.
Rory - match on Saturday vs Dunmore, he's captain now. Big deal for him.

Siddharth and Meera's twins arrived early, October 14th! Both in special care but doing ok. Siddharth sounded exhausted on the phone. Drop round some food this weekend, and don't ask too many questions. Meera's parents are staying with them till the 31st, so maybe go after that. Their older boy Theo starts nursery next month as well.
Jen's wedding in Tuscany is now 12 June 2027. She wants us there for the whole week. Need to book flights before prices go mad.
Xavier told me Bethany is pregnant again, baby number three. Still early so keep it quiet. Bethany's mum is moving in to help when it arrives.
Tadhg Murphy is doing the Ironman in Cork, July 2027. Swims every morning at 6. He's vegan now as well, so no more takeaway nights with him.
Mehmet's flight from Istanbul got cancelled, he's stuck there till Tuesday. Missing his daughter's recital on 11/3 because of it. He's absolutely gutted. Remind me to video it for him.
Freya Olsen loves anything to do with Formula 1. Has a framed Hamilton shirt in her hall. Birthday's December 2nd.
Tanvi's dog Biscuit had his operation yesterday, knee ligament. Tanvi was in bits beforehand but he's home now and eating. Check on her Friday.
Akira (Aki to everyone) is singing in the Messiah at the cathedral on December 15th. Tickets are £18. I'm going with Lila. Akira says she wants flowers afterwards, half joking.

Spent ages with Chioma and Lola at the park. Chioma's thinking about a home birth, which Lola thinks is mad. Lola's off to Thailand on January 8th for a month, solo trip, first since her divorce. Lola's nervous but excited. Chioma's due date is mid-February so Lola might miss it. Both want a proper night out before then, I said I'd organise it. Ask them both for dates by the end of the week.
Luis is coaching the under-10s now. They've got a tournament in Leeds on November 29th. His son Mateo is the goalie.
Kieran's partner Dorota is 32 weeks. They're both nervous because the last pregnancy was so hard. Baby shower is Sunday 16 November. Get something off the list for them.
Eli has moved to Melbourne for work, starts March 2nd. His mum is heartbroken, she's flying out at Easter. He wants us to visit in 2027 sometime.
Note to self: renew travel insurance before Spain trip, 3 December 2026.
Theo and his wife Ilse are doing a big Christmas party on December 20th. Ilse said no presents, just bring a dish. Theo wants a karaoke machine, so maybe chip in with the others.

Bumped into Khadija at the school gates. Her son Aarav is in the Christmas nativity on Dec 10, he's a sheep and very proud. Her husband works nights so she's doing most of it alone at the moment. She looked shattered. Offer to take Aarav one afternoon.

Zhang just got back from Vietnam. Three weeks, motorbikes through the north. He's got about 2000 photos and wants to show me. Lost his phone in Hanoi but got it back. Says the food was the best of his life.
Björn ran 5k in under 25 mins on Saturday! Been trying since spring. Congratulate him at football Thursday.

Adriana Rossi and her husband Rory are hosting the christening for little Sofia on the 23rd. Rory's brother Kieran is godfather. Adriana's dad isn't well enough to travel so they'll stream it for him. I'm reading at the service, need to practise. Kieran's wife Lola is doing the flowers and said she'd love help on the Saturday morning.
Yetunde's daughter Ruby is doing her grade 5 violin exam on 11/18. Yetunde says she practises two hours a day. Wish Ruby luck the night before.
Rosa's off to New York on May 14 for her 40th. Her partner Siddharth booked it as a surprise but she found the confirmation email. She's pretending not to know. Bring it up carefully.

Called Rana. Her grandad passed away on Monday. Funeral is in Lahore on the 30th so she's flying out Thursday with her mum and brother Mehmet. She's ok-ish, mostly worried about her mum. Send flowers to the house before Thursday and message her while she's away.
Ruby's into bouldering now, three times a week. Also obsessed with sourdough. Easy birthday ideas.
Jen's son had his first swimming gala yesterday. Came last in both races but loved it. Jen's already bought him new goggles. Ask how the next one goes in December.
Xavier and Bethany cancelled the Iceland trip, Bethany's pregnancy is too far along to fly. They're doing a cottage in Wales instead, week of 8 March.
Siddharth said Meera's sister Tanvi got into the Royal Ballet School! Starts September 2027. Whole family's thrilled.
Rory's mum Mrs Murphy had her hip done on 10/28. Rory's taking two weeks off work to look after her. He's struggling, mostly from lack of sleep.
Mehmet's band are in the Battle of the Bands final, Saturday 22 November 2026. He's dead calm about it, weirdly. Freya and I are going.
Lars says the Copenhagen trip is off, work wouldn't give him the time. Rebooked for April 2027. Björn's sulking.
Akira and Tanvi had their baby! Hana, born November 3rd at 4am. Akira sent a photo, she's tiny. Should arrange a visit in a couple of weeks, once they've settled. Also send something for Hana.
Busy weekend: Freya's 10k on Saturday morning, then Chioma's baby shower Sunday at 2, and Lila's leaving drinks Monday. I'm cooking for the shower.
Dorota's grandma is turning 90 on 1/15. Dorota's flying to Poland for the party. She'd love one of those digital photo frames for her, said it twice.
Lola and Eli - Eli's proposing in Paris at New Year! Lola has no idea. Eli asked me to help pick a ring Saturday.
Kieran just got back from the Paris trip. Food poisoning on the last day, poor man. He's still a bit grey. Check on him tomorrow.
Rosa Santos. Neighbour at 14. Has a cat called Pepper. Works as a midwife at the General. Her daughter Lila is at uni in Glasgow.
Freya's daughter is starring in the dance competition in Blackpool, March 2027. Freya wants to drive up the day before. She's nervous about the drive, not the dance.

Long catch-up with Meera, Yetunde and Adriana at brunch. Meera's pregnant, 12 weeks, first scan was Tuesday and everything looked good. Yetunde's planning a trip to Lagos over Christmas with the kids, first time they'll meet their great-grandma. Adriana's training for the London marathon in April 2027 and has got a charity place for the hospice that looked after her dad. She's raising money, I said I'd sponsor her. Meera's due date is 2 June 2027. Must sponsor Adriana before payday runs out, and send Meera a congrats card.
Theo wants to do a cycling trip across Vietnam in 2027. Talks about it constantly.
Ilse's daughter's christening is moved from December 7th to January 11th because the vicar's ill. Lars and I are godparents. Ask Ilse what we're meant to bring.
Sorted the boiler finally. Quote was £340. Still need to book the MOT.
Tadhg's sister Bethany ran the Berlin marathon and got a PB, 3:28! Tadhg's so proud he cried. Message Bethany congratulations.
Chioma's mum is coming over from Lagos when the baby arrives, staying three months. Chioma's both relieved and slightly terrified. Her husband is quietly panicking about space.
Lila's play opens Thursday at the Playhouse, she's the understudy but on for two nights. She's nervous as hell. Buy tickets for the Friday, maybe bring Luis.
Siddharth (Sid) is doing a solo exhibition, his photos from Japan, gallery opening on 5/14. He's anxious no one will come. Rally people.
Zhang's mum had a fall last Tuesday. Broken wrist. She's staying with Zhang and Dorota for now. Zhang's working from home to help. Pop round with soup.

Aarav's off to Mumbai for his cousin's wedding on the 27th, 10 days. He's dreading the flight with a toddler. His wife Khadija is staying behind with the baby. Text Aarav when he lands. Khadija says her mum will stay over most nights, so she won't be alone. Their flight back is November 6th.
Yetunde's son Tadhg turned three yesterday. Huge dinosaur party. Yetunde said next year she's doing a small one, never again.
